name: listing-questions-are-answered
pins: "What do I have?" is answered from the rows, before planning. Live, three phrasings dead-ended in one session while a fourth worked - nothing separated them except which sentence the Coordinator felt like planning for, which is not a property a patient can be asked to guess. Answering *before* the Coordinator rather than after it is the whole fix: a fallback for when planning fails would still be a lottery, because a wrong plan is as likely as no plan (the mock plans "show my appointments" as a booking and asks which department). Every turn here also asserts `reply_author: template` - the answer is assembled from rows, so a model-authored reply would mean the query path never ran even if the words happened to be right. The last two turns are the controls: an action naming the same nouns must still book, and a genuinely off-topic message must still be refused.
